description: List the images and videos in the ad account (read-only), newest first, to find a media_id for snap_create_creative, snap_create_story_creative or snap_create_collection_creative. By default only READY media; filter by type and name. Reads every page; a note says when the list is cut.

ad_account_id.description: Ad account id. Optional: defaults to SNAP_AD_ACCOUNT_ID (set by setup). snap_ping shows the current one.

limit.description: Most rows to return. Lower it for a shorter answer; the answer says if more exist.

name_contains.description: Only items whose name contains this text (not case sensitive).

offset.description: Skip this many rows (for the next page, use next_offset from the previous answer).

ready_only.description: true = only media Snap has finished processing (READY).

response_format.description: concise = only id, name and status; detailed = every field.

type.description: Filter by type (see the tool description for the choices).

name: snap_list_media
